records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Engaged early: project created day 1 ([email:0803d7e6]) and welcome call held ([calendar:97e4883b]), but no customer-initiated replies to three touches, no invites sent, no tickets, and 8 days left. Momentum stalled after setup, so unaided activation is possible but below even odds.

draft.subject: Next step after your first project
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week — good to see Pioneer Analytics already has a real project going. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so the usual next step is getting the work and the people who own it into that project.

When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your project with you and suggest how to structure it.

Best,
Priya
